text:
mike: We're scheduled to bring up ap-southeast1 cluster next week. Quick check — have quota & reservations been requested for A100-80GB and T4 fallback? Need ~32 A100s + 96 T4 for bootstrap. Who can confirm ticket & ETA? Also need a provisional budget number.

ashley: Opened cloud ticket CLD-789432 and added justification. Requested regional quota increases: 32 x nvidia-a100-80gb, 96 x nvidia-t4. Asked for a temporary reservation window 2026-05-03 -> 2026-05-10 for bootstrap. cc @riley for reservation orchestration.

riley: I can take the reservation flow. Proposal: provisional quota increase -> create short-term commitment/reservation -> validate with 4 nodes -> scale to full. Prefer ephemeral reservation then convert to longer commit if tests look good. When do we want validation?

mike: Prefer validation kickoff 2026-05-03 08:00 UTC. Also need mgmt subnet (/29), peering with prod-vpc, and firewall rules for healthchecks. Who is owning peering?

sophia: I own peering/firewall. Send me project IDs and desired CIDRs. I'll also confirm KMS key access and rotation policy.

ashley: Commands I used for the provider (GCP example):
```
gcloud compute reservations create rwd-ap-sea-boot --zone=ap-southeast1-a --specific-reservation --accelerator-type=nvidia-a100-80gb --accelerator-count=32 --commitment=1-month
```
And quick quota check: 
```
gcloud compute regions describe ap-southeast1 --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
Adjust to AWS/Azure equivalents as needed.

infra-bot: ticket CLD-789432 updated — provider acknowledged, asked for org justification; ETA 48-72h. :white_check_mark: 

riley: Created internal reservation request R-2026-042 and linked terraform PR: https://git.internal/rwd/infra/pull/1245. Provider shows soft-allocated 32 A100 and 96 T4 pending approval. Reservation ID R-2026-042. CI has post-checks that verify quotas before apply.

sophia: Firewall rules I need to apply (summary): allow 6443/icmp/ntp from mgmt range, allow healthcheck probes from provider IPs, ssh from ops range, block public access to GPU nodes. Will paste exact rules shortly.

mike: Budget estimate ballpark? If we're 32 A100s for a 7-day boot: what's that look like vs a T4 fallback? Also prefer preemptible/fallback plan to reduce cost during boot if we can.

ashley: Quick numbers: A100-80GB ~ $8.5/hr (on-demand-equivalent), T4 ~ $0.35/hr. Rough calc for 32 A100s 24/7 for 7 days -> 8.5 * 32 * 24 * 7 = $45,888. Add margin for networking/storage/egress -> provisional budget $50k. Finance ticket FIN-562 opened for approval.

riley: Validation checklist (I'll run and post artifacts):
- Boot a k8s node with GPU driver + docker (nvidia-container-runtime)
- Run smoke perf: `./tools/bench/gpu_smoke.sh`
- KV cache warming script run on toy model (5k tokens)
- Measure p95/p99 on toy model, target p99 < 120ms
- Node drain test -> fallback to T4 nodes
- Verify autoscaler reacts and no service interruption

sophia: Network checklist: 
- VPC peering established and routes propagated
- Firewall rules applied
- Internal DNS records created for node hostnames
- NAT gateway validated for egress
I'll confirm each item before 05:00 UTC day-of.

mike: Handoff plan: after validation we do a canary (10% of traffic) for 6 hours, then increase. Who is oncall for canary window?

ashley: ops-oncall (Rita) scheduled that day. I'll ping Rita for coverage and escalation list.

infra-bot: Reservation R-2026-042 created in provider sandbox at 2026-04-30T14:02Z. Status: PENDING_APPROVAL.

riley: Once provider approves, `terraform apply` will create subnet and reservation. PR contains smoke tests in CI that will fail the apply if quotas aren't present. I'll post the PR link in the ticket.

sophia: FYI provider asked for org-level justification for >24 GPUs. Added product roadmap link and sprint id to CLD-789432.

mike: Please add a short rollback playbook into the runbook before we start. If reservation partial-fails we need clear steps: cancel reservation, drain nodes, revert autoscaler, notify partners.

ashley: Will add rollback steps to the bring-up runbook. Key rollback highlights I'll add now: 
- Cancel reservation/commitment request with provider support
- Drain and cordon nodes in cluster, shift traffic to fallback region/T4 pool
- Revert any autoscaler/policy changes made for bring-up
- Open procurement escalation (contacts + phone numbers in runbook)
Link to runbook: https://confluence.internal/rwd/infra/bringup-runbooks#rollback

riley: I'll post test logs here once reservation transitions to ACTIVE. Will also leave a short quick-check script in the PR for on-call to run. cc @sophia @ashley

infra-bot: CLD-789432 status changed to APPROVED by provider at 2026-04-30T18:12Z. Reservation R-2026-042 now ACTIVE in sandbox. :party_parrot:

mike: Great — thanks everyone. Keep updates short here and paste the final smoke logs and the terraform apply output.

ashley: Noted. I'll update the finance ticket with final numbers after we see actual hours used.

rita: I'll be on-call for the canary window and have the escalation list ready. Ping me 30m before canary start.

riley: test logs: https://artifacts.internal/rwd/bringup/R-2026-042/smoke-logs.tar.gz (uploaded). All smoke tests passed on 4 node sample; p99 = 98ms for toy model.

infra-bot: Thread archived into CLD-789432 after finalization.
